littles_law.description: Little's Law: L = lambda * W with example: 1000 rps * 50ms = 50 concurrent workers needed

pool_sizing.description: Pool sizing: CPU-bound = cores, I/O-bound = cores * (wait_time / compute_time)

fixed_pool.description: Fixed thread pool with unbounded queue growing to OOM vs bounded queue with backpressure

rejection_policies.description: Four rejection policies when bounded queue is full, CallerRunsPolicy recommended for web servers

fork_join_pool.description: ForkJoinPool divide-and-conquer: fork large task into subtasks, process parallel, join results

work_stealing.description: Work stealing: LIFO pop from own deque (cache local), FIFO steal from others (large tasks first)

go_runtime.description: Go M:N scheduling: millions of goroutines (2-8KB stack) multiplexed onto OS threads with work stealing

virtual_threads.description: Java 21 virtual threads: lightweight JVM threads, unmount from carrier on I/O block

loom_gotchas.description: Virtual thread gotchas: synchronized pinning, expensive thread locals, CPU-bound limitations

summary.description: Summary: Little's Law sizing, work stealing benefits, virtual threads as future direction
